prompt: Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a luxurious decorative envelope as the main subject, positioned in the foreground and occupying a strong central presence in the frame. The envelope feels handcrafted, premium and refined, with realistic paper texture (soft matte, subtle fibers, delicate pearlescent accents), elegant folds and precise geometry. The closure is finely detailed and tactile, with a polished wax seal, satin ribbon, or ornamental clasp inspired by a playful pool party aesthetic. The envelope is placed within a rich, story-driven environment, not a flat backdrop. The background forms a vibrant summer pool party scene — with a sparkling swimming pool, colorful inflatable rings, tropical decor, sun loungers, umbrellas, palm leaves, and festive outdoor lighting — softly blurred but visually recognizable. Water reflections, party decorations, cocktails, and cheerful summer elements create depth and context while keeping the envelope as the clear hero. Surrounding elements are carefully curated and symbolic, including floating petals, confetti, shimmering water droplets, bubbles, light sparkles, and subtle tropical accents, arranged organically around the envelope. These elements feel natural, floating gently, enhancing motion and celebration without overpowering the composition. Lighting is cinematic and dramatic, with soft key light illuminating the envelope, delicate rim light outlining its edges, and warm sunlight mixed with reflective water caustics casting dynamic highlights. Subtle mist, atmospheric haze and floating particles catch the light, creating a dreamy, festive and premium mood. Shadows are soft, realistic and directional. The color palette is vibrant and varied, inspired by a pool party celebration — turquoise, aqua, coral, pink, yellow, lime green, orange, and touches of gold — with smooth gradients, luminous highlights and controlled contrast. Composition: foreground-focused, envelope sharply in focus, background softly defocused, strong sense of depth and perspective. Camera: macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on envelope texture, seal and ornaments, cinematic bokeh in background lights. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic realism, elegant, festive, premium invitation aesthetic. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, luxurious, visually enchanting, suitable for premium invitations, celebrations and storytelling visuals.
instruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de envelope
folhaInstruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de de uma folha em branco com adornos em torno, sendo essa folha o objeto central e principal da imagem, ocupando quase a tela toda, mas ainda deixando espaço para visualizar o chão, o fundo e os elementos laterais
cartaoPrompt: Gere um cartão vertical 9:16 elegante, na mesma atmosfera, no tema (Pool Party) e na paleta de cores (Cores variadas). Como identificação do evento, escreva apenas "Aniversário Janaina Nunes". Escreva também a frase exata "Clique para abrir o convite!". Copie ambas literalmente, sem acrescentar idade, data, horário, endereço ou outros dizeres, e deixe-as visíveis, legíveis e integradas ao design.
aberturaInstruction: Crie um prompt de geração de vídeo para essa imagem com a abertura do envelope e um brilho saindo de dentro, no final o brilho vai fazer a tela ficar toda em branco sólido ao aumentar o brilho.
aberturaPrompt:
A animação começa focando em um envelope fechado com um único selo de cera. Assim que o selo de cera se desprende fisicamente e cai no chão, ele não é substituído, duplicado nem regenerado em momento algum. O envelope permanece permanentemente aberto após esse instante, sem que surja qualquer outro selo.
Uma vez removido o selo, a aba do envelope se levanta lentamente. De seu interior, emergem brilhos cintilantes, poeira brilhante e rastros de luz radiante, espalhando-se pelo ambiente em um espetáculo hipnotizante, com feixes mágicos de partículas luminosas que se curvam em torno do envelope, passando à sua frente e por trás em um movimento contínuo. Essas partículas originam-se apenas de dentro do envelope, aumentando em densidade e luminosidade à medida que se deslocam.
A luz radiante se intensifica e se expande para fora, preenchendo gradualmente toda a cena. Nenhum novo objeto físico é introduzido durante essa transição. O brilho intenso dos feixes e das partículas transforma-se em uma tela branca sólida e deslumbrante no quadro final. A câmera aplica um zoom sutil e lento.
aberturaSlide2Prompt: Remove the envelope from the image completely, revealing only the beautiful background scene, keeping all other elements intact. The result should look natural without any envelope.

aberturaSlide3AnimPrompt: Smooth cinematic animation of a luxurious pool party anniversary scene, with a gentle camera drift and subtle parallax across the pool area, tropical decor, umbrellas, loungers, and softly glowing background lights. The water surface should move naturally with realistic ripples and shimmering caustics, reflecting sunlight and colored decor in a dynamic but elegant way. Add floating bubbles, drifting confetti-like sparkles, and tiny airborne particles that move slowly through the light for a dreamy festive atmosphere. Palm leaves and decorative accents should sway very lightly as if touched by a soft summer breeze. Warm sunlight and reflective highlights should subtly pulse and shift, with delicate volumetric rays and atmospheric haze enhancing depth. Keep the motion refined, premium, and continuous, with no characters, no text, no speaking, and no abrupt transitions. The camera movement should remain smooth and stable, using a slow cinematic push-in or lateral glide to preserve the luxurious invitation aesthetic while emphasizing the vibrant pool party environment.
